newsitem.title: USA: Stephan to buy assets of Morris-Flaming.
newsitem.headline: Stephan to buy assets of Morris-Flaming.

text.p: The Stephan Co said Thursday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets and assume certain liabilities of Morris-Flamingo LP, a distributor of barber and beauty supplies.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The company said that based on historical data,the acquisition could increase its sales by more than $14 million annually.
Closing, said Stephan, is subject to a definitive agreement, satisfactory completion of due diligence and approval by the board of directors.
